## Workload

Lena Fischer completed 799 reads during the reporting period, working a total of 384 hours. This represents a rate of 2.1 reads per hour. The workload was recorded for review against the expected session pattern and provides the basis for assessing both activity and consistency.

The review considered the volume of work completed alongside the time spent undertaking it. This provides a clear summary of the grader’s activity and supports comparison with the quality findings below.

## Quality

A sample of 51 reads was checked as part of the review. The level of agreement was 78.4 per cent. These findings provide an indication of the consistency of the grading decisions within the reviewed sample.

The current session pattern was considered alongside the review results. The document was reviewed by Priya Anand.
